_readme: Tuning + text fixes for tools/vo/generate.js. Editing this file changes ONLY
the generated audio — no game code reads it.
cueText       — per-cue replacement for the VO Text column of VO-narration.md.
Required for every cue whose table text contains a [placeholder],
because a TTS engine speaks the brackets out loud.
pronunciation — whole-word, case-insensitive substitutions applied to every cue.
voiceSettings — passed straight through to the ElevenLabs request.
outputFormat  — mp3_44100_128 matches the existing files. mp3_44100_64 halves size
if the 5.7 MB VO payload is too heavy for low-end Android.
seed          — fixed integer keeps re-runs byte-stable where the model supports it.
Set to null to let the API choose.
